verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a managed database service and its tooling (such as CHKit), so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. BYOC data residency and private networking are adjacent data-locality controls, not telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
